title: Data Scientist
description:
Job Type: Full-time

About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and passionate Data Scientist to join our Data team and play a pivotal role in driving our organization towards a Data-Driven culture. You will be responsible for transforming raw data into meaningful insights and developing mathematical/machine learning models to solve complex business problems and optimize our products.

Key Responsibilities
Data Analysis & Modeling: Develop, validate, and test Machine Learning Models (e.g., Predictive Modeling, Classification, Clustering) to address business challenges and improve operational efficiency.

Data Mining & Exploration: Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and analyze large datasets (Big Data) to uncover hidden patterns, trends, and actionable insights.

Data Preparation: Perform data cleaning and feature engineering in collaboration with Data Engineers to ensure data quality and readiness for modeling.

Visualization & Reporting: Design intuitive dashboards and present analytical findings through Data Visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to communicate effectively with business stakeholders.

Deployment & Monitoring: Collaborate with Software Engineers and DevOps teams to deploy models into production environments and continuously monitor model performance.

Experimentation: Design and analyze A/B tests to measure the impact of product changes and new features.

Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.

Programming: Proficiency in Python or R with strong hands-on experience in libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.

SQL: Expert-level knowledge of SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.

Machine Learning: Deep understanding of ML algorithms (Regression, Decision Trees, Neural Networks, NLP, etc.).

Statistics: Strong foundation in statistical analysis (Hypothesis testing, Probability distributions).

Communication: Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders (Data Storytelling).

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
Experience with Cloud Platforms (AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure).

Knowledge of Deep Learning Frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras).

Experience working with Big Data tools (Spark, Hadoop).

Familiarity with MLOps practices or Model Lifecycle Management tools (MLflow, Airflow).

Tech Stack We Use
Languages: Python, SQL

Cloud: AWS (S3, EC2, SageMaker)

Database: PostgreSQL, BigQuery

Visualization: Power BI / Tableau

Tools: Git, Docker, Jira
